final: WITH f AS (SELECT CASE WHEN TRIM(k_symbol) = '' THEN '' ELSE k_symbol END AS k, amount FROM "order" WHERE amount >= 2802), g AS (SELECT k, AVG(amount) AS avg_amt FROM f GROUP BY k), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS overall FROM g) SELECT g.k, g.avg_amt, g.avg_amt - o.overall AS excess_over_overall FROM g, o WHERE g.avg_amt > o.overall ORDER BY g.avg_amt DESC
